arxiv-2011-12473.title: Two-level systems with periodic N N -step driving fields: Exact dynamics and quantum state manipulations
arxiv-2011-12473.creator: Zhi-Cheng Shi, Ye-Hong Chen, Wei Qin, Yan Xia, X. X. Yi, Shi-Biao Zheng, Franco Nori
arxiv-2011-12473.description: Abstract In this work, we derive exact solutions of a dynamical equation, which can represent all two-level Hermitian systems driven by periodic N N -step driving fields. For different physical parameters, this dynamical equation displays various phenomena for periodic N N -step driven systems.

arxiv-2012-07641.title: Best Arm Identification in Graphical Bilinear Bandits
arxiv-2012-07641.creator: Geovani Rizk, Albert Thomas, Igor Colin, Rida Laraki, Yann Chevaleyre
arxiv-2012-07641.description: Abstract We introduce a new graphical bilinear bandit problem where a learner (or a central entity ) allocates arms to the nodes of a graph and observes for each edge a noisy bilinear reward representing the interaction between the two end nodes.

arxiv-2110-02177.title: Secure Aggregation for Buffered Asynchronous Federated Learning
arxiv-2110-02177.creator: Jinhyun So, Ramy E. Ali, Başak Güler, A. Salman Avestimehr
arxiv-2110-02177.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Jinhyun So, Ramy E. Ali, Başak Güler, A. Salman Avestimehr. Federated learning (FL) typically relies on synchronous training, which is slow due to stragglers. While asynchronous training handles stragglers efficiently, it does not ensure privacy due to the incompatibility with the secure aggregation protocols. A buffered asynchronous training protocol known as FedBuff has been proposed recently which bridges the gap between synchronous and asynchronous training to mitigate stragglers and to also ensure privacy simultaneously.

arxiv-2202-02676.title: Autocorrelation, Wigner and Ambiguity Transforms on Polygons for Coherent Radiation Rendering
arxiv-2202-02676.creator: 1 st Jacob Mackay, 2 nd David Johnson, 3 rd Graham Brooker
arxiv-2202-02676.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by 1 st Jacob Mackay, 2 nd David Johnson, 3 rd Graham Brooker. Simulating the radar illumination of large scenes generally relies on a geometric model of light transport which largely ignores prominent wave effects. This can be remedied through coherence ray-tracing, but this requires the Wigner transform of the aperture. This diffraction function has been historically difficult to generate, and is relevant in the fields of optics, holography, synchrotron-radiation, quantum systems and radar.

arxiv-2208-14497.title: Internal rotation and inclinations of slowly pulsating B stars: Evidence of interior angular momentum transport
arxiv-2208-14497.creator: May G. Pedersen
arxiv-2208-14497.description: Abstract One of the largest uncertainties in stellar structure and evolution theory is the transport of angular momentum in the stellar interiors. Asteroseismology offers a powerful tool for measuring the internal rotation frequencies of pulsating stars, but the number of such measurements has remained few for ≳ 3 ​ M ⊙ \gtrsim 3\,{\rm M}_{\odot} main-sequence stars.

arxiv-2312-10471.title: Evidence of sharp transitions between octahedral and capped trigonal prism states of the solvation shell of the Fe +3 (aq) ion
arxiv-2312-10471.creator: Amrita Goswami, Alejandro Peña-Torres, Elvar Ö. Jónsson, Sergei A. Egorov, Hannes Jónsson
arxiv-2312-10471.description: Abstract The structure of the solvation shell of aqueous Fe +3 ion has been a subject of controversy due to discrepancies between experiments and different levels of theory. We address this issue by performing simulations for a wide range of ion concentrations, using various empirical potential energy functions, as well as density functional theory calculations of selected configurations.

arxiv-2507-19577.title: Detecting dark objects in the Solar System with Gravitational Wave observatories
arxiv-2507-19577.creator: Valentin Thoss, Abraham Loeb
arxiv-2507-19577.description: Abstract Dark objects streaming into the solar system can be probed using gravitational wave (GW) experiments through the perturbations that they would induce on the detector test masses. In this work, we study the detectability of the resulting gravitational signal for a number of current and future GW observatories.

arxiv-2509-00731.title: LLM Encoder vs. Decoder: Robust Detection of Chinese AI-Generated Text with LoRA
arxiv-2509-00731.creator: Houji Jin, Negin Ashrafi ID, Armin Abdollahi, Wei Liu, Jian Wang, Ganyu Gui, Maryam Pishgar ID, Huanghao Feng
arxiv-2509-00731.description: Abstract The rapid growth of large language models (LLMs) has heightened the demand for accurate detection of AI-generated text, particularly in languages like Chinese, where subtle linguistic nuances pose significant challenges to current methods. In this study, we conduct a systematic comparison of encoder-based Transformers (Chinese BERT-large and RoBERTa-wwm-ext-large), a decoder-only LLM (Alibaba’s Qwen2.

arxiv-2601-03412.title: Approximating stable translation lengths on fine curve graphs
arxiv-2601-03412.creator: Federica Fanoni, Sebastian Hensel, Frédéric Le Roux
arxiv-2601-03412.description: Abstract . We study the stable translation length of homeomorphisms of a surface acting on the fine nonseparating curve graph and compare it to the stable translation lengths of its finite approximations — mapping classes relative to a finite invariant set — acting on the nonseparating curve graph.

pmc-11367480.title: Epithelioid angiomyolipoma with vascular invasion: An aggressive presentation of an unusual AML variant
pmc-11367480.creator: Jacob Van Vorst, Madeline L Berkowitz-Cerasano, Mrinali Tripathi, Jin Dugho, Francis Flaherty
pmc-11367480.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Renal angiomyolipoma (AML) is a typically benign renal tumor that is divided into 2 classes, the classical variant and the more aggressive epithelioid variant. It is extremely rare for an AML to exhibit aggressive features such as vascular invasion. We present the case of a 36-year-old female who presented with right lower quadrant pain for 9 months and was found to have an AML with tumor extension into the renal vein and the IVC.

pmc-12469839.title: Thriving from Work Questionnaire: Validation of a Measure of Worker Wellbeing Among Older U.S. Workers
pmc-12469839.creator: Maren Wright Voss, Cal J Halvorsen, Kanchan Yadav, Stephanie M Neidlinger, Gregory R Wagner, Susan E Peters, Iffath Syed
pmc-12469839.description: As life expectancy and retirement ages rise globally, understanding how older workers thrive in the workplace is an increasingly vital measurement and wellbeing priority. In this study, we validated the Thriving from Work Questionnaire (TfWQ) for workers aged ≥50. A U.S. online panel yielded 617 older workers and 372 younger counterparts for comparison.

pmc-12556544.title: Who cares? Demography of the working-age population affected by parents with dementia
pmc-12556544.creator: K Korhonen, P Martikainen
pmc-12556544.description: BackgroundAs the number of older individuals with dementia rises and public long-term care provision is retrenched, caregiving responsibilities increasingly fall on adult children. However, little is known about the demographic and socioeconomic characteristics of the working-age population affected, specifically their age, gender, socioeconomic status, and family circumstances.

pmc-12969223.title: Dynamic coactivation patterns during repetitive negative thinking: A cross-sectional fMRI study
pmc-12969223.creator: Marvin Sören Meiering, Emily Belleau, David Weigner, Rebecca Gruzman, Diego Pizzagalli, Sören Enge, Simone Grimm
pmc-12969223.description: BackgroundRepetitive negative thinking (RNT) and neuroticism are risk factors for internalizing psychopathology. However, their interaction has only been investigated at the self-report level, and studies elucidating their interrelationship at the neural level are lacking. We therefore investigated the interaction of trait RNT and neuroticism with respect to the dynamics of neural networks during negative self-referential processing.

pmc-13045375.title: Beyond Diagnosis: Transdiagnostic Cognitive Subgroups in Mood Disorders Linked to Work‐Related Disability
pmc-13045375.creator: Ryo Sawagashira, Takuro Tsutsumi, Hayato Watanabe, Atsuhito Toyomaki, Ryo Okubo, Naoki Hashimoto, Takahiro A Kato
pmc-13045375.description: AimCognitive dysfunction is a transdiagnostic feature of mood disorders and a key determinant of functional outcomes. This study aimed to identify transdiagnostic cognitive heterogeneity among patients with mood disorders using a data‐driven approach and to examine its association with social functioning.

A self-propelled, uninspected passenger vessel shall be operated by an individual licensed by the Secretary to operate that type of vessel, under prescribed regulations.

uslaw-usc-t7-s6522.title: 7 U.S.C. § 6522 — Funding
uslaw-usc-t7-s6522.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s6522.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 94 (Organic Certification). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In general There are authorized to be appropriated for each fiscal year such sums as may be necessary to carry out this chapter. (b) National organic program Notwithstanding any other provision of law, in order to carry out activities under the national organic program established under.
